title: FragmentOp
description: A chemically meaningful fragment-level molecular edit action. Represents a single step in molecular optimization that operates at the level of molecular fragments rather than individual atoms/bonds.

op_type.description: The type of fragment-level operation being performed. Vocabulary v0 contains exactly 5 action types.

enumDescriptions.attach_fragment: Attach a new fragment to an open attachment point on the molecule. Does not remove any existing fragment.
enumDescriptions.replace_substituent: Replace an existing side-chain substituent with a different fragment. Removes a leaving group and attaches a new fragment at the same anchor.
enumDescriptions.grow_r_group: Extend an R-group by appending an additional fragment to its terminal point. Scaffold is always preserved.
enumDescriptions.bioisostere_swap: Replace a fragment with a bioisosteric equivalent (same pharmacophoric properties, different chemical structure). Scaffold may or may not be preserved depending on swap site.
enumDescriptions.delete_fragment: Remove an existing fragment/substituent from the molecule without replacing it. Leaves the anchor atom with a free valence (implicitly filled with H).

anchor.description: Specifies where in the parent molecule the operation is applied.

anchor_atom_indices.description: Atom index or indices (in the parent molecule) that serve as the attachment/detachment site. Usually 1 atom for attach/delete, 2 atoms for replace (bond-level anchor).

anchor_frag_idx.description: Index of the fragment (in BRICS/Murcko decomposition of the parent molecule) that contains the anchor atom(s). Null if decomposition was not performed.

anchor_env_type.description: Local chemical environment tag at the anchor atom, e.g. BRICS environment type (integers '1'–'16') or a free-text label such as 'aromatic_C', 'aliphatic_N', 'carbonyl_C'. Null if not annotated.

anchor_position_encoding.description: Additional positional context. E.g. 'scaffold_edge' (anchor is on a bond connecting scaffold to R-group), 'ring_atom', 'chain_end'. Null if not annotated.

fragment.description: Describes the incoming fragment being introduced by the operation (for attach_fragment, replace_substituent, grow_r_group, bioisostere_swap). For delete_fragment, this object is null.

fragment_id.description: Stable identifier for this fragment in the action library. Format: '{source}:{canonical_smiles_hash}' or '{source}:{template_id}'. Must be unique within an action library version.

fragment_smiles.description: SMILES of the incoming fragment. Attachment points are marked with '[*]' or '[*:N]' where N is the attachment point index.

attachment_points.description: List of attachment point descriptors within the fragment. Each entry maps to a '[*:N]' wildcard in fragment_smiles.

ap_index.description: Attachment point index (matches the N in '[*:N]' SMILES notation). Use 0 or 1 for single-point attachments.

ap_atom_idx_in_fragment.description: Atom index within the fragment's own atom numbering that bonds to the anchor.

fragment_size.description: Number of heavy atoms in the fragment (excluding wildcard attachment atoms).

enumDescriptions.brics: Fragment derived from BRICS decomposition of a known molecule.
enumDescriptions.rgroup: Fragment defined as an R-group substituent from a matched molecular series.
enumDescriptions.mcs_extracted: Fragment extracted from MCS-based alignment of a molecule pair.
enumDescriptions.template: Fragment comes from a manually or data-derived template action library.
enumDescriptions.manual: Manually defined fragment for testing or seeding.

leaving_group.description: The fragment that is removed during replace_substituent or delete_fragment. Null for attach_fragment and grow_r_group.

matched_atom_indices.description: Atom indices (in the parent molecule) belonging to the fragment/substituent being removed.

leaving_fragment_smiles.description: SMILES of the fragment being removed. Attachment point marked with '[*]'.

leaving_group_size.description: Number of heavy atoms in the leaving group (excluding wildcard attachment atom).

connection.description: Describes the bond formed (or broken) between anchor atom and the incoming fragment.

bond_type.description: Bond order of the new bond formed. 'none' for delete_fragment where no bond is formed.

attachment_mapping.description: Maps anchor atom index to fragment attachment point index. Key: anchor atom index (string), Value: fragment ap_index.

topology_change.description: High-level description of topological impact on the molecular graph.

constraints.description: Structural and chemical constraints that can be computed for this action. All fields are boolean flags (True = constraint is satisfied).

scaffold_preserving.description: True if the Murcko scaffold of the resulting molecule is identical to the Murcko scaffold of the parent molecule. First-version rule: compare canonical Murcko SMILES of parent and product.

rgroup_only.description: True if the action only modifies R-groups (side chains) and does not touch the scaffold at all. Stricter than scaffold_preserving. Null if not annotated.

ring_change.description: True if the action introduces or removes a ring system (topology_change in ['forms_ring', 'breaks_ring']). Null if not annotated.

charge_change.description: True if the formal charge of the molecule changes as a result of this action. Null if not annotated.

valence_safe.description: True if the resulting molecule passes RDKit sanitization (no valence violations, no invalid chemistry).

provenance.description: Tracks how this action record was created.

enumDescriptions.rule_brics: Generated by applying BRICS fragmentation rules.
enumDescriptions.data_mcs: Extracted from (smiles_from, smiles_to) pair via MCS alignment.
enumDescriptions.data_mmp: Extracted from a matched molecular pair (MMP) database.
enumDescriptions.template: Instantiated from a pre-defined template action.

template_id.description: ID of the template this action was instantiated from. Null if source is not 'template'.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule that generated this action (e.g. 'brics_rule_3_to_5', 'rgroup_swap_NH'). Null if source is not rule-based.

confidence.description: Confidence score [0.0, 1.0] for data-extracted actions. Based on MCS coverage ratio or MMP frequency. Null for rule-generated actions.

actionlib_version.description: Version of the action library this action belongs to (e.g. 'actionlib_v0', 'actionlib_v1'). Null if standalone.
